raw.description: 战斗开始时，为己方附加4座蜃楼|回合开始时，若对手当回合未选择技能，则2回合内自身受到的非真实伤害减少50%，若对手选择了技能，则自身当回合与此技能类型相同的技能使用后令对手石化1回合，不同的技能先制+1|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]战斗开始时，为[color=#52a5f2]己方[/color]附加4座[color=#f35555]蜃楼[/color]|[sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]回合开始时[/color]，若[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color][color=#52a5f2]当回合[/color]未选择技能，则2回合内自身受到的非[color=#52a5f2]真实伤害[/color]减少50%，若[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color]选择了技能，则自身[color=#52a5f2]当回合[/color]与此技能类型相同的技能使用后令[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color][color=#57c975]石化[/color]1回合，不同的[color=#52a5f2]技能先制[/color]+1

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 缺少四对应技能时不转化不生成已答，原状态、既有蜃都及剩余次数保留；完整配置顺序及逐/理仍通过真实状态验证。
review.singleBehavior: 初始4蜃楼；控制异常在控制抗性槽中且未免疫/抗住时，仅当前1~4完整携带序曲/源数/逐海/理律才将其转3回超频并按实装顺序生成首个未转换蜃都。缺任一招原控制照施加，不生成不消费；已有城不删除，恢复配置继续原次数。敌选择类型、石化、未选技能减非真伤、逐延长和理PP各分支保留。
review.deferredBehavior: 蜃都之序的真实首末位精灵触发条件；蜃都之源使真实主动下场改为驱逐；己方楼状态跨真实队伍成员承接。
review.trigger: 双方首位、末位精灵的效果触发；双方的主动下场；己方共享状态随真实队伍交接
futureMechanisms: 主动换宠及驱逐生命周期

dependencyEvidence.quote: 双方首位、末位精灵的效果触发无视顺序条件
双方的主动下场视为驱逐下场

success.name: 4923真实2119初始四蜃楼，四个实装技能顺序的真实异常转超频与逐双向延长
success.assertion: test('4923真实2119初始四蜃楼，四个实装技能顺序的真实异常转超频与逐双向延长',()=>{const s=make({move:29398,soul:true,loadout});resistance(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,29398,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119;assert.deepEqual(st.cities.map(x=>x.name),['序','源','逐','理'].slice(0,r));assert.equal(st.remaining,4-r);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],r+2);}observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.a,'凝滞',c.t,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.t,'凝滞',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(s,38460,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞'],7);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['凝滞'],7);});

success.name: 4923真实2119免疫抵抗与非控制不转楼，未完整携带四招时原控制保留不生成不消费
success.assertion: test('4923真实2119免疫抵抗与非控制不转楼，未完整携带四招时原控制保留不生成不消费',()=>{for(const mode of['immune','resist','aux','none']){const s=make({move:29398,soul:true,loadout});resistance(s,mode==='aux'?'超频':'害怕',mode==='resist'?100:0);if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='none')s.fighters[0].build.resistance.slots=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,mode==='aux'?'超频':'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,29398,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);}const s=make({move:38464,soul:true});resistance(s);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,38464,20117));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.cities,[]);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],undefined);});

success.name: 4923真实2119敌选技能不同类先制1，相同类实际用招石化1；整招无效仍使用，被控和药剂不算
success.assertion: test('4923真实2119敌选技能不同类先制1，相同类实际用招石化1；整招无效仍使用，被控和药剂不算',()=>{for(const mode of['different','same','invalid','controlled','potion']){const s=make({move:38464,soul:true});if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'attackBlock');if(mode==='controlled')s.fighters[0].ailments['睡眠']=2;let stone;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)stone=c.t.ailments['石化'];},()=>turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:38464,mode==='different'?20117:10127));if(mode==='different'){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);assert.equal(stone,undefined);}else if(['same','invalid'].includes(mode)){assert.equal(stone,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(10127)],40);}else assert.equal(stone,undefined);}});

success.name: 4923真实2119敌未选技能减非真伤50%持续两回合，真伤及直接损失不减，第三回到期
success.assertion: test('4923真实2119敌未选技能减非真伤50%持续两回合，真伤及直接损失不减，第三回到期',()=>{for(const type of['fixed','percent','true','direct']){const s=make({move:38464,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.a,100,'fixture',type,true&&type==='direct');},()=>turn(s,38464,null));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,['fixed','percent'].includes(type)?8950:8900);}const s=make({move:38464,soul:true}),z=make({move:38464});turn(s,38464,null);turn(z,38464,null);turn(s,38464,10716);turn(z,38464,10716);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s,'attack',1)-sum(z,'attack',1)*.5)<=1);turn(s,38464,10716);turn(z,38464,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),sum(z,'attack',1));});

success.name: 4923蜃都之理双方当前无法选择的真实技能回末各回1PP，可选技能不补且来源序条件免PP仍可选
success.assertion: test('4923蜃都之理双方当前无法选择的真实技能回末各回1PP，可选技能不补且来源序条件免PP仍可选',()=>{const s=make({move:29398,soul:true,loadout});s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.cities=[{name:'理'},{name:'序'}];for(const f of s.fighters){f.pp[f.moves[0]]=0;f.pp[f.moves[1]]--;}turn(s,29398,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29395)],0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29396)],4);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(10127)],39);assert.ok(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(29395)));});

success.name: 4923魂印真实登场异常转换亦依实装逆序，超频转换不再受免异/逐延长影响
success.assertion: test('4923魂印真实登场异常转换亦依实装逆序，超频转换不再受免异/逐延长影响',()=>{const s=observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===0){c.a.build.resistance.slots=[{name:'害怕',chance:0},{name:'',chance:0},{name:'',chance:0}];c.entryAilment(c.a,'害怕',2,c.t);}},()=>make({soul:true,move:29398,loadout:[38460,29397,29396,29395,29398]}));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.cities.map(x=>x.name),['理']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});

success.name: 4923已答未完整携带四对应技能均不转化不生成：逐一缺任意一招，原害怕睡眠冰封实际生效、次数和PP不消费
success.assertion: test('4923已答未完整携带四对应技能均不转化不生成：逐一缺任意一招，原害怕睡眠冰封实际生效、次数和PP不消费',()=>{for(let missing=0;missing<4;missing++)for(const name of['害怕','睡眠','冰封']){const loadout=full.slice();loadout[missing]=38464;const s=make({move:38464,soul:true,loadout});resist(s,name);const pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(38464)];incoming(s,name);assert.equal(st(s).remaining,4);assert.deepEqual(st(s).cities,[]);assert.equal(st(s).conversions,undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments[name]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38464)],pp);assert.equal((s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,0);assert.equal(st(s).rejectedLayouts.length,1);}});

success.name: 4923已答更换成其他技能停止转换且不删除已有蜃都，恢复完整配置后仍按当前位置生成首个未转化者
success.assertion: test('4923已答更换成其他技能停止转换且不删除已有蜃都，恢复完整配置后仍按当前位置生成首个未转化者',()=>{const s=make({move:29398,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:full});resist(s,'害怕');incoming(s,'害怕');assert.deepEqual(st(s).cities.map(e=>e.name),['序']);assert.equal(st(s).remaining,3);s.fighters[0].moves[0]=key(38464);assert.ok(s.moveDefinitions[key(38464)]);s.fighters[0].pp[key(38464)]=s.moveDefinitions[key(38464)].pp;incoming(s,'害怕');assert.deepEqual(st(s).cities.map(e=>e.name),['序']);assert.equal(st(s).remaining,3);assert.equal(st(s).conversions.length,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']);s.fighters[0].moves[0]=key(29395);incoming(s,'害怕');assert.deepEqual(st(s).cities.map(e=>e.name),['序','源']);assert.equal(st(s).remaining,2);assert.equal(st(s).conversions.length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频']);});

success.name: 4923已答无剩余蜃楼时完整配置原转换仍保留，但换成其他技能仍不转换，不因remaining为0绕过配置检查
success.assertion: test('4923已答无剩余蜃楼时完整配置原转换仍保留，但换成其他技能仍不转换，不因remaining为0绕过配置检查',()=>{const s=make({move:29398,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:full});resist(s,'害怕');for(let n=0;n<4;n++)incoming(s,'害怕');assert.equal(st(s).remaining,0);assert.deepEqual(st(s).cities.map(e=>e.name),['序','源','逐','理']);incoming(s,'害怕');assert.equal(st(s).conversions.length,5);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频']);s.fighters[0].moves[0]=key(38464);s.fighters[0].pp[key(38464)]=s.moveDefinitions[key(38464)].pp;incoming(s,'害怕');assert.equal(st(s).conversions.length,5);assert.equal(st(s).remaining,0);assert.equal(st(s).cities.length,4);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],undefined);});

boundary.assertion: test('4923真实2119初始四蜃楼，四个实装技能顺序的真实异常转超频与逐双向延长',()=>{const s=make({move:29398,soul:true,loadout});resistance(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,29398,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119;assert.deepEqual(st.cities.map(x=>x.name),['序','源','逐','理'].slice(0,r));assert.equal(st.remaining,4-r);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],r+2);}observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.a,'凝滞',c.t,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.t,'凝滞',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(s,38460,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞'],7);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['凝滞'],7);});

boundary.name: 4923真实2119免疫抵抗与非控制不转楼，未完整携带四招时原控制保留不生成不消费
boundary.assertion: test('4923真实2119免疫抵抗与非控制不转楼，未完整携带四招时原控制保留不生成不消费',()=>{for(const mode of['immune','resist','aux','none']){const s=make({move:29398,soul:true,loadout});resistance(s,mode==='aux'?'超频':'害怕',mode==='resist'?100:0);if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='none')s.fighters[0].build.resistance.slots=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,mode==='aux'?'超频':'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,29398,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);}const s=make({move:38464,soul:true});resistance(s);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,38464,20117));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.cities,[]);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],undefined);});

success.assertion: test('4923/1561最大HP差盾上限150，同源刷新与异源保留；真实击破授下一次实际攻击等量威力，清盾不授',()=>{for(const gap of[0,50,200,-100]){const s=make({...row(1561),bStats:{maxHp:9000+gap}});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,Math.min(150,Math.abs(gap)));turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,Math.min(150,Math.abs(gap)));}const s=make({...row(1561),bStats:{maxHp:9100},loadout:[29395,38464,29397,38460,29398]});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===1)c.minimumDamage=200;},()=>turn(s,29395,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.miragePower1561.amount,100);const z=structuredClone(s);delete z.fighters[0].soulState.miragePower1561;turn(s,38464,20117);turn(z,38464,20117);assert.ok(sum(s)>sum(z)*2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.miragePower1561,undefined);turn(s,38464,20117);turn(z,38464,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(z));});

interaction.name: 4923同版37118/37124仅复用既有原始确认：零冗余参数保留，错宠版本技能版本参数模板及缺证均不能放行
interaction.assertion: test('4923同版37118/37124仅复用既有原始确认：零冗余参数保留，错宠版本技能版本参数模板及缺证均不能放行',()=>{assert.deepEqual(errors(source),[]);for(const id of[37118,37124])for(const mode of['pet','version','args','metadata','template','confirmation']){const bad=structuredClone(source),m=bad.moves.find(m=>m.id===id),meta=bad.effects.find(e=>e.id===m.effectInstances[0].id);if(mode==='pet')bad.source.revision='bad';if(mode==='version'){m.hash='bad';m.revision='seerapi:bad';}if(mode==='args')m.effectInstances[0].args=[1];if(mode==='metadata')meta.revision='seerapi:bad';if(mode==='template')meta.template+='changed';if(mode==='confirmation')delete m.sourceParameterConfirmation;assert.ok(errors(bad).some(e=>e.includes(':skill:'+id+':0')),id+':'+mode);}for(const [owner,id]of[[4600,37118],[4604,37124]]){const code="const fs=require('fs'),read=fs.readFileSync;fs.readFileSync=function(file,...args){if(String(file).endsWith('/"+owner+"-user-confirmations.json')||String(file).endsWith('\\\\"+owner+"-user-confirmations.json'))throw Error('test missing original authorization');return read.call(this,file,...args);};const P=require('./completion-policy.cjs'),s=require('./research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4923/snapshot.json'),errors=P.validateCoverage(s,{entries:{}},{records:[]},process.cwd());if(!errors.some(e=>e.includes(':skill:"+id+":0')&&e.includes('instance parameters must match source argsNum')))process.exit(1);";const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['-e',code],{cwd:process.cwd(),encoding:'utf8'});assert.equal(result.status,0,result.stderr);}});

success.name: 4923同版37118/37124仅复用既有原始确认：零冗余参数保留，错宠版本技能版本参数模板及缺证均不能放行
success.assertion: test('4923同版37118/37124仅复用既有原始确认：零冗余参数保留，错宠版本技能版本参数模板及缺证均不能放行',()=>{assert.deepEqual(errors(source),[]);for(const id of[37118,37124])for(const mode of['pet','version','args','metadata','template','confirmation']){const bad=structuredClone(source),m=bad.moves.find(m=>m.id===id),meta=bad.effects.find(e=>e.id===m.effectInstances[0].id);if(mode==='pet')bad.source.revision='bad';if(mode==='version'){m.hash='bad';m.revision='seerapi:bad';}if(mode==='args')m.effectInstances[0].args=[1];if(mode==='metadata')meta.revision='seerapi:bad';if(mode==='template')meta.template+='changed';if(mode==='confirmation')delete m.sourceParameterConfirmation;assert.ok(errors(bad).some(e=>e.includes(':skill:'+id+':0')),id+':'+mode);}for(const [owner,id]of[[4600,37118],[4604,37124]]){const code="const fs=require('fs'),read=fs.readFileSync;fs.readFileSync=function(file,...args){if(String(file).endsWith('/"+owner+"-user-confirmations.json')||String(file).endsWith('\\\\"+owner+"-user-confirmations.json'))throw Error('test missing original authorization');return read.call(this,file,...args);};const P=require('./completion-policy.cjs'),s=require('./research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4923/snapshot.json'),errors=P.validateCoverage(s,{entries:{}},{records:[]},process.cwd());if(!errors.some(e=>e.includes(':skill:"+id+":0')&&e.includes('instance parameters must match source argsNum')))process.exit(1);";const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['-e',code],{cwd:process.cwd(),encoding:'utf8'});assert.equal(result.status,0,result.stderr);}});

success.assertion: test('4923/191反弹优先计次免异，2109次数成功清敌回合和正级，962无强化全二、已有全一，843次两回全先制2',()=>{const p=make(row(191));p.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20117));assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.ok(p.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']);const s=make(row(2109));s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;timer(s,1,'test-round');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['test-round'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);for(const boost of[0,1]){const x=make(row(962));x.fighters[0].stages.atk=boost;turn(x,x.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].stages.def,boost?1:2);}const a=make({...row(843),loadout:[29397,38464,29395,29396,29398]});turn(a,29397,20117);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(a,38464,20117);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);}});

success.name: 4923/191反弹优先计次免异，2109次数成功清敌回合和正级，962无强化全二、已有全一，843次两回全先制2
success.assertion: test('4923/191反弹优先计次免异，2109次数成功清敌回合和正级，962无强化全二、已有全一，843次两回全先制2',()=>{const p=make(row(191));p.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20117));assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.ok(p.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']);const s=make(row(2109));s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;timer(s,1,'test-round');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['test-round'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);for(const boost of[0,1]){const x=make(row(962));x.fighters[0].stages.atk=boost;turn(x,x.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].stages.def,boost?1:2);}const a=make({...row(843),loadout:[29397,38464,29395,29396,29398]});turn(a,29397,20117);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(a,38464,20117);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);}});

success.name: 4923全部17招有序编译和64种子基础状态，2119原生17招及蜃楼状态真实执行
success.assertion: test('4923全部17招有序编译和64种子基础状态，2119原生17招及蜃楼状态真实执行',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}});
